entry.summary: A governance-first architecture for zero-capital agentic businesses. Frontier models pushed the price of machine cognition toward zero, and the obvious inference — that any connected individual now owns a software company — proves fragile in practice. entry.summary: The traffic source nobody told you about. A complete operating manual for one under-used traffic channel: the psychology of the scroll-stop, a pin factory run from Canva on a phone, the search optimisation playbook, a scheduling system that survives real-life disruption, and the money layer that turns attention into a payout.…

entry.title: The Rocket Man Reckoning
entry.summary: How China mocked Elon Musk — and why they are now panicking. The arrogance of a rising superpower, the collapse of its myths, and what one company's success reveals about the future of innovation. A short book about a decade of ridicule from established voices — academic, industrial and editorial — and what happened when the engineering arrived anyway.…
